title: Derived comparison Hom bijection with bounded below target
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category, with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions, as in the existing derived comparison construction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For etale derived objects K and M with M bounded below, the exact inverse image induces a bijection Hom(K,M) to Hom(nu* K,nu* M). In particular this applies to modules over any commutative coefficient ring.

proof.text: The comparison unit is invertible on bounded below objects: comparison inverse image sends injectives to comparison-pushforward-acyclic objects, and the underived unit is invertible.
Use the unbounded derived adjunction to identify the map on Hom with postcomposition by this unit followed by the inverse adjunction bijection. Both maps are bijections.
